---
title: Compatibility
toc: false
---

Voicenotes needs a microphone and watch firmware with Connect IQ 6.0.3 or later.

## Watch models

The watch app has builds for these device families.

| Family | Models |
| --- | --- |
| Approach | S72 |
| D2 | Air X15, Mach 2 Pro |
| Enduro | 3, 4 |
| fēnix | E, 8, 8 Solar, 8 Pro, 9, 9 Pro, 9 Pro Solar |
| Forerunner | 70, 170, 170 Music, 570, 970 |
| MARQ | Gen 3 |
| quatix | 8, 8 Pro |
| tactix | 8, 8 Solar |
| Venu | 4, X1 |
| vívoactive | 6 |

[Install](install.qmd) · [Companion](android-sync.qmd)

## Watch storage

You can keep up to 40 notes on your watch. If storage fills or a recording is interrupted, Voicenotes keeps any audio it already saved and marks the note **Partial / interrupted**. To free space, [delete a recording you no longer need](index.qmd#listen-to-or-delete-a-note).
